capabilities: Download web images in notes to a Cloudflare R2 bucket and rewrite links
Upload pasted, dropped, and existing vault images to R2
Restore original web links from stored original addresses
Convert images to WebP and deduplicate by content hash
Retry failed uploads and run bulk jobs per note or whole vault
extras: Manifest carries the note 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' Docs cover security caveats: keys stored per device, unencrypted in data.json if synced with the vault, and uploaded images are publicly viewable by link. A Chinese-language README is also referenced.
motivation: The README states the gap directly: 'If the author deletes the post, the images in your note are gone.'
problem: Images in clipped web articles remain on the original site and disappear if the author deletes the post or the site blocks hotlinking.

relations.evidence: keeps them in your own Cloudflare R2 (Cloudflare's cloud storage: free up to 10 GB

requires.name: Cloudflare R2 bucket with custom domain

summary: Image uploader that stores web-clipped and pasted images in your own Cloudflare R2 bucket and rewrites note links to your copies.
